Outstanding performance of the afternoon came from James Ryle. Improving with every race and relishing the tough conditions James had enough confidence to go off in the top dozen and he hung on well to finish 16th.

James Ryle, in his first cross country season for Belgrave, won his county vest with a fine eighth position in the Hampshire Championships. James found the tough, muddy Havant course suited his strong running and he finished in a time of 38:41 with the winner, James Starling of Southampton, returning 37:09.

It was newcomer James Ryle who again produced the best run of the day finishing in 11th position, just ahead of Frank Ward. Nice to see Frank gradually returning to fitness in time for the twelve stage.

Belgrave's only senior male representative was James Ryle He found the early searing pace rather uncomfortable but held on well to finish a very creditable 216th and will benefit greatly from the experience.
